# Aspire Agency

> Aspire is an outsourced sales and marketing team for B2B tech companies, based at Rambla de Catalunya 8, Barcelona, Spain, and working across Europe. Founded in 2022 by Elena Novikova. Four specialists cover four disciplines: sales, business development, paid acquisition and content. The offer is a full growth function without hiring one in house: strategy in week one, execution in week two. 35+ projects delivered, 1M+ audience reached, 15 international projects. First call is free and lasts 15 minutes. Pricing is on request and scoped per engagement.

## What Aspire does
- [Sales, in person and digital](https://www.aspireagencymarketing.com/services/sales): lead research against a real buyer profile, multichannel outreach, strategic follow up, conference representation and CRM management. B2B buying cycles rather than consumer funnels.
- [Business development](https://www.aspireagencymarketing.com/services/business-development): positioning, brand, website and SEO, partnerships and audience, wired into the sales pipeline rather than run beside it.
- [Social media management](https://www.aspireagencymarketing.com/services/social-media): LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok and Instagram end to end. Strategy, content calendar, creation, posting, community and monthly analytics.
- [Content creation](https://www.aspireagencymarketing.com/services/content-creation): photography, long and short form video, branded visuals and live event capture. One shoot cut for every channel.

## Specialisms
- [Real estate and yachting](https://www.aspireagencymarketing.com/real-estate): listing photography, cinematic walkthroughs, drone and on-water filming for agencies, developers, brokerages and charter operators, plus the channel management behind it.
- [AI systems](https://www.aspireagencymarketing.com/ai-systems): custom dashboards, lead scoring and enrichment, retrieval assistants trained on a client's own documents, and workflow automation. Built in the client's own cloud; source and documentation handed over at the end.

## Why clients choose Aspire over the alternatives
- Hiring in house takes two to four months and buys one skill set. A retainer agency puts a junior team behind an account manager. Aspire is four senior specialists, starting in weeks, scoped to the work.
- Sales and marketing are run as one plan, so content feeds social, social warms outreach, and outreach closes.
- Monthly reporting on outcomes rather than activity, with the plan changed against real results.

## Evidence
- [Client cases](https://www.aspireagencymarketing.com/work): BUNQ (fintech, partnership coordinator for the Spanish market, 1,000+ new users onboarded in the first 2.5 months); SilTest Semiconductors (two years of LinkedIn, business development and onsite sales); Integrated Systems Europe (a year as onsite marketing partner at the largest AV show in the world); RCK Consulting (website, lead generation, CRM and conference representation); De Interim Notaris (website and SEO for a Netherlands legal practice); The Craft Cigar Club (membership growth and corporate venue rentals in Barcelona).
- Reported averages across managed accounts: 500+ leads captured in the last 30 days, 8% social engagement rate, 12% sales conversion rate.
